test_policy.notes: SAT or ACT scores are optional (the international page says so directly). The SAT essay is not required.

requirements.notes: Apply through the Common App, the St. Edward's application or ApplyTexas. The $50 fee is waived for applications by Jan. 1 (Early Application deadlines). Required: online application, essay, high school or college transcripts and an academic recommendation form; TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or Kaplan Test of English if English is not the first language (Kaplan accepted on a provisional basis). The undergraduate deadlines page lists an additional Nov. 1 'First Review' date; it does not appear on the international page. Whether the Early Application plans are binding is not stated; no early decision plan is mentioned.

deadlines.label: Early Application (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: No application fee if applied by this date. Dates are printed without a year and treated as the fall 2027 cycle.

deadlines.label: Early Application II (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: No application fee if applied by this date.

deadlines.label: Priority Application (Moreau and other academic scholarships)
deadlines.notes: The international page ties this date to the Moreau Scholarship and other academic scholarships.

deadlines.label: Final Application (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Last date to be considered for fall admission; earlier applications are encouraged.

deadlines.label: Final enrollment deposit
deadlines.notes: Non-refundable deposit (students admitted late deposit within two weeks of acceptance).

deadlines.label: CSS Profile priority deadline (international applicants, new students)
deadlines.notes: St. Edward's CSS Profile code is 6619. No CSS Profile fee waiver.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The international page requires TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo English Test or Kaplan Test of English (provisional) only 'if English is not your first language'. Exemption rules and minimum scores for first-year applicants are not published on the pages reviewed; the 79 iBT / 6.0 IELTS / 550 ITP figures found on the site apply to a partner dual-degree program, not to first-year applicants.

english.notes: Duolingo English Test accepted; no first-year minimum published.

aid.notes: Undergraduate international students are considered for academic scholarships through the admission application, and for need-based grants by filing the CSS Profile for international applicants (code 6619, priority Feb. 15). First-year merit scholarships range from $14,000 to $32,000 a year for students admitted through regular admission (not limited to internationals); the Moreau Scholarship (full tuition, one per Holy Cross high school) lists international applicants submitting test or English scores. Not eligible for U.S. federal loans. Whether the university is need-blind or meets full need for internationals is not stated.

sat.note: Printed on the international admission page.

act.note: Printed on the international admission page.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages reviewed; have ETS send scores to St. Edward's University.
